Cylindrical shaped electromagnetic force–driven aircraft - China patent

#ufotwitter

Patent describes a cylindrical-shaped flying craft (UFO-like) that uses electromagnetic forces instead of traditional propellers or jet engines to generate motion.

👉 The key concept:

A circular (ring-shaped) electromagnetic system
Generates force along the circumference
Produces lift and propulsion without visible rotating blades

⚙️ How It’s Supposed to Work

       Electromagnetic Ring Drive

The craft contains a ring structure with coils or conductors
Electric current flows through them
This creates electromagnetic fields and forces

➡️ These forces act around the ring, potentially:

Pushing air/plasma
Or interacting internally (depending on interpretation)

Control Mechanism

By adjusting current intensity / direction in different parts of the ring:

The craft can tilt

Change direction

Stabilize itself

🧠 What It’s REALLY Based On

Despite the futuristic look, this is grounded in known physics:

Lorentz force (force on moving charges in a magnetic field)

Electromagnetic actuation

Possibly ionized airflow or plasma effects

The patent includes a schematic diagram of an elongated, oval/elliptical vehicle with internal structures, rotors or coils, a cabin section, and what appear to be propulsion or control elements.

That part on top of the vehicle is some kind of opening.

There are a few mistranslations in this patent because the vehicle is clearly cylindrical or in the shape of a tic-tac.
